messages:
amy (AE): Hey team — Finovia wants a Dedicated POC next week. They need a stable egress allowlist (single announced IP per region) and AZ failover. Can we sketch the access plan + rough cost note for the quote?

carlos (SE): Thanks — quick Qs: do they want provider-managed static IPs from our Dedicated pool or will they supply expect-to-allow customer NAT IPs?

amy (AE): They said they can only allow a short list of IPs on their firewall. Prefer we give them a stable set. Also asked about TLS client certs for mutual auth.

maria (SRE): We can allocate static EIPs per dedicated endpoint in each region. Failover plan: primary AZ EIP -> automatic failover to secondary AZ with a second EIP. There will be a brief TCP reconnect.

carlos (SE): Implementation notes: routing uses our egress NAT gateway tied to the Dedicated pool. We'll announce two EIPs (primary/secondary) per region. If they insist on single IP across AZs, we need a cross-AZ NAT with elastic failover (SLA implications).

amy (AE): They asked if IP rotation will break sessions / KV cache for long-running chat.

maria (SRE): Rotation will flush per-connection state only if source IP changes mid-session. Recommend sticky routing + graceful drain during failover to avoid KV cache misses.

carlos (SE): For mTLS: we support optional client certs at the dedicated endpoint. Need CA bundle from Finovia or use our managed certs?

amy (AE): They prefer to present a client cert from their infra team. I asked them to send the cert chain and CN.

netops-bot: Reminder: request for static EIPs requires 48h lead time for allocation and security review.

carlos (SE): Action items: (1) SE to prepare network diagram + NAT EIP list per-region (2) SRE to propose failover behavior and downtime window (3) AE to collect client cert chain and exact firewall allowlist CIDRs.

amy (AE): Can you also add a short pricing note — hourly for Dedicated pool + one-off setup for static EIPs + optional managed mTLS add-on? They want a ballpark before legal.

maria (SRE): Ballpark: Dedicated small pool (4 vGPU-equivalent) ~$2.4/hr, EIP allocation/setup one-off $800, managed mTLS onboarding $1,200 (one-time). These are estimates, will confirm with finance.

carlos (SE): I'll draft the network handoff template they can paste into their firewall team. Amy, want me to attach it here?

amy (AE): Please. Also flag any fields they may not have (e.g., ASN, expected SNIs).

carlos (SE): Dropping sample block for their firewall rule set:```src_ip: 203.0.113.45/32  # primary eip
src_ip_failover: 203.0.113.46/32  # secondary eip
ports: 443
protocol: TCP
notes: allow TLS SNI and client cert verification
```

amy (AE): Perfect — forwarding to Finovia infra. Will loop back once they confirm cert + allowlist. :thumbsup:

maria (SRE): FYI — if they require single IP across AZs we should schedule a 1hr maintenance window and call out a 30s reconnection expectation in the SLOs.

amy (AE): Got it. Thanks everyone, great thread.
